answer: The Markdown editor is 531 by 344 on rgb(242, 242, 242). Numbers rgb(102, 102, 102), right aligned in a column 20 wide for one digit and 25.9 for two, beside a 10.4 fold column, so the gutter is 31.4 or 37.3 and the text moves right with it. Text starts 11 below the top and 6 in from the gutter; lines are 22. The band is rgba(211, 211, 211, 0.267) on the line and both gutter columns, covers a whole wrapped line under one number (66 for three rows), shows on the empty field and stays when focus leaves. Placeholder rgb(136, 136, 136). A selection is rgb(215, 212, 240) in up to three pieces: 16 tall on its first row, down to the last row, then 16 tall on the last, as wide as the editor but for the last, with the text over it. Marks rgb(64, 71, 64); url, a --- line and a fence's language rgb(34, 17, 153); tag names rgb(0, 136, 85); brackets plain. A heading is bold and underlined, marks too. Strong bold, emphasis italic, both with their marks. Backticks are marks and what they hold is plain. A link or image is underlined throughout, its text plain, its url blue. In [r]: /z only the [r] is a link. A list mark and a quote's > are marks, the text after has no span. ~~del~~ has no spans. Seen, not measured: a fold chevron in the fold column on headings, fences and HTML lines. With everything selected over mixed lines Bold and Italic dim: the cause is unread.
